capabilities: task-management | Keeps projects and tasks with due dates, labels, assignees and file attachments, in a web interface and over a REST API.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official Vikunja image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Vikunja is a self-hosted to-do and project management application: it organizes tasks into projects with list, table, Gantt and Kanban views, and supports labels, due dates, priorities, assignees, comments, file attachments, sharing by link and a REST API with API tokens. Everything is kept in the instance's own SQLite database and files folder, stored in the `vikunja` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel. Open `https://<instance>/` and use Register to create your account; the first account you create is an ordinary user, and Vikunja has no administrator to set up. Registration is open by default because a closed instance has no way to create a user from the web interface; close it afterwards with the **Allow registration** parameter. You can run one Vikunja instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Vikunja documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

VIKUNJA_SERVICE_ENABLEREGISTRATION.description: Whether anyone who can reach the instance address may create an account. Keep it true until you have registered your own account: with registration closed, Vikunja has no way to create the first user from the web interface. Then set it to false so nobody else can register. It is read at every start of the instance.
VIKUNJA_SERVICE_ENABLEREGISTRATION.title: Allow registration

VIKUNJA_SERVICE_SECRET.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. Vikunja signs sign-in tokens with it, so changing it signs everyone out. Anyone who knows it could forge a sign-in, so keep it private.
VIKUNJA_SERVICE_SECRET.title: Signing secret
